[1] However, he is reliant on skill shots for his combo, and he does lack any mobility at all.

[1] He can apply three stacks onto a large monster or enemy champion, and when he does, they get a ring around them. After 2 seconds, this explodes, dealing damage to the champion hit and all other enemies around them.
[1] Brand's Q is a straight line skill shot, which deals damage to the first enemy hit. However, if the target's ablaze, it stuns them as well.
[1] Brand's W places down a circle on the floor, and after a short delay, it erupts dealing damage to all enemies within.

[1] However, if the target's ablaze, the circle this spreads in is massive, and this is a really easy way to poke enemies in lane where a minion's burning and you use E on the minion to spread it to the champions.
[1] This will then bounce to another nearby enemy and can bounce up to four times. Otherwise, if there are no other enemies nearby, it can bounce back to Brand and then back to the enemy hopefully.

[1] Your W absolutely chunks enemies and you can throw it out fairly often. However, once you have access to level three, hitting your full combo which also procs your full hit passive is ridiculous damage.
